title: Cascade bondRecipient asymmetry in AggregateVerifier.resolve
summary: Identified that resolve() cascade branch (parent CHALLENGER_WINS) sets status=CHALLENGER_WINS but does NOT update bondRecipient when counteredByIntermediateRootIndexPlusOne>0. Honest challenger of child gets no reward when parent fails first.
key_lesson: Pashov Multiproof Audit 1 #1 documented this resolve branch and the FIX intentionally lets the cascade branch fast-resolve so proposer reclaims bond. The bondRecipient-stays-as-gameCreator behavior is the INTENDED remediation, not a bug. Pre-flight rule 6: when audit fix commits document the divergent behavior, do NOT file. Cantina dd587c9 is the documented-design anchor.
